name: koalafix
description: One memory for every AI tool on your team. Facts show who checked them and when.

interface.shortDescription: Team memory for your AI tools
interface.longDescription:
KoalaFix is one shared memory for a software team that uses more than one AI tool. ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and other MCP clients connect to the same hosted server, so a note saved from one tool can be recalled from any other.

What you can do from ChatGPT or Codex:
- Recall memory. Ask before you act. You get a verdict first (clear, stale, conflict or unknown), then the facts, notes and what teammates are working on.
- Remember a note. Save something worth keeping. Notes are private unless you save them to the team.
- Verify a fact. Mark that you checked a fact's source and it still holds, or record the new value.
- Track work. Claim a task before you start and see whether a teammate is on overlapping work. Finish it, or hand it over.
- List open items. What is waiting on you or the team, who owns it and how it closes.
- Settle an item. Retire a note, dismiss an item, pass it to its owner, undo, or resolve a disagreement once you have decided.
- Share to the team. Copy one of your private notes to the team, only after you say yes.

Every fact carries a sticker: who checked it and when. An answer checked ten minutes ago looks different from one nobody has looked at since last month. When two people save different values, the one with more standing on the team wins, a lower-standing value waits as a challenge, and equal standing opens a dispute for a person to settle. Nothing is silently overwritten.

Who it's for: software teams of 3 to 15 people where most people use AI agents daily and the team uses two or more different AI tools on the same work. People who don't write code are welcome too. A founder in ChatGPT can read what a developer's agent saved from Codex.

Limitations:
- You need a KoalaFix account. You sign in on the KoalaFix sign-in page the first time you connect.
- Track work records what an agent says it is doing and has done. KoalaFix does not check that the work was really done.
- KoalaFix stores text and links, not files.
- It refuses notes that look like secrets or keys. Store a pointer to your secret manager instead.
- It stores only what you and your agents save to it. It does not read your ChatGPT memory or chat history.
- Recall keeps a log of the questions asked, with secrets removed, so your team can see what memory could not answer.

It's early. Tell us where it breaks.
